text:
[Council File 15-0989-S72]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a plan addressing homeless encampment resolution and unhoused outreach and housing placement during the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
Recommendations for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Harris-Dawson - Yaroslavsky):
1. INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO), Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and Los Angeles Housing Department, in coordination with Los Angeles World Airports, Los Angeles Metro, the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority, and Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles, to report in 90 days on a plan addressing homeless encampment resolution and unhoused outreach and housing placement during the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (2028 Games). This report should include, but not be limited to, plans to address the following:
a. Unhoused resolution and outreach at areas surrounding Olympic venues and at transit hubs and corridors
b. Detailing the outreach and encampment resolution timeline and process
c. Anticipated response levels during the 2028 Games
d. Current response considerations
e. Cost recovery
f. A list of any potential funding sources that can support placing people experiencing homelessness (PEH) into interim or permanent housing, including any potential State Encampment Resolution Funds (ERF), philanthropic dollars, Measure United to House Los Angeles (ULA), Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions Agency (LACAHSA), or other applicable state and local resources
g. A proposed timeline for implementing the plan
h. A plan to bring uninhabitable units to code and regulatory compliance with the goal to expedite housing for PEH
i. The cost and feasibility of expanding time limited subsidies across the city for PEH
2. REQUEST the County of Los Angeles to activate additional capacity in homelessness programs that each County department funds, as identified in the Motion (Jurado – Blumenfield; Council file No. 26-1412), dated October 6, 2026, to ensure that higher-level of care beds, such as Mental Health, Substance Use, and Recuperative Care beds, are available in advance of the 2028 Games.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes statement For: North Westwood Neighborhood Council
(Ad Hoc Committee on the 2028 Olympics and Paralympics Games waived consideration of the above matter)
summary: Motion asking the city administrative office and legislative analyst to report on a plan for encampment resolution and unhoused outreach and housing placement during the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
